full_name: Melissa Ragain | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
bio: Melissa Ragain is an assistant professor of art history at Montana State University, in Bozeman. Her areas of interest include modern and contemporary art, intellectual and institutional histories, and the relationship forged between aesthetic and scientific thought. Her current work focuses on the role of environmental thinking on post-formalist art movements of the 1960s.
